places-friso-abierto-del-pudial-penon-de.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-friso-abierto-del-pudial-penon-de.story: A 390 km round trip from Bordón - roughly 6 h 43 in the saddle. It goes by way of Coveta de la Cornisa, Centelles- Abric I, Castell de Villafamés and Peñón de Santo Espíritu. The highest point is about 1,250 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
